articles.title: Hundreds of websites deliver potent malware cocktail to unsuspecting visitors
articles.content: Malware cocktail delivers cryptocurrency theft payloads and iOS exploits, among other things.
articles.titleZh: 数百个网站向毫无戒心的访客提供强大的恶意软件组合
articles.contentZh: 恶意软件组合会传播加密货币盗窃负载和 iOS 漏洞利用等内容。

articles.title: Grok Bot took unapproved actions, ignored orders to stop, and then denied it
articles.content: AI agent takes unapproved actions even when laptop lid is closed and told not to.
articles.titleZh: Grok Bot 采取了未经批准的操作，无视停止指令，然后否认此事
articles.contentZh: 即使笔记本电脑的盖子已合上且被告知不要采取行动，AI 代理仍会采取未经批准的行动。

articles.title: Shareholders sue Intel, its CEO, and CFO after stock drops 28.6 percent in one day
articles.content: The PC sales slump "more than offset” AI boom gains, shareholders say.
articles.titleZh: 英特尔股价一天内大跌28.6%，股东起诉英特尔及其首席执行官和首席财务官
articles.contentZh: 股东表示，个人电脑销售的暴跌“远远抵消了”人工智能热潮带来的收益。

articles.title: Windows 0-day dropped by disgruntled researcher hands hackers System rights
articles.content: "SignDrop" exploit lets local users gain all-powerful System rights.
articles.titleZh: 不满的研究人员泄露Windows 0-day漏洞，黑客获得系统权限
articles.contentZh: “SignDrop”漏洞利用可让本地用户获得全权系统权限。

articles.title: Satya Nadella says he’s AGI-pilled now
articles.content: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella says he's AGI-pilled, at least when it comes to how AI might make startling changes to the structure of the economy and how politics might change because of it. "I am AGI-pilled in the sense that at an economy level, what is the political economy's organization around AGI?" he asked at […]
articles.titleZh: 萨蒂亚·纳德拉表示，他现在已经“AIG化”了
articles.contentZh: 微软首席执行官萨蒂亚·纳德拉表示，他非常看好AGI，至少在谈到人工智能可能会对经济结构带来惊人变化以及政治可能会因此而发生变化时，他非常看好AGI。他在……上问道：“我之所以对AGI抱有信心，是因为在经济层面，围绕AGI的政治经济组织是什么样的？”

articles.title: Jeff Bezos says he was ‘heavily involved’ in picking the new James Bond
articles.content: Robert Pattinson's casting as James Bond made enough sense given his recent work with director Denis Villeneuve, who's making the franchise's next film over at Amazon. But it turns out that Amazon founder Jeff Bezos played a significant role in making the final decision, too. During Semafor's Silicon Valley and the World conference today, Bezos […]
articles.titleZh: 杰夫·贝索斯表示，他“深度参与”了新任詹姆斯·邦德的选拔。
articles.contentZh: 考虑到罗伯特·帕丁森最近与导演丹尼斯·维伦纽瓦的合作，他被选为詹姆斯·邦德的扮演者是完全合理的，后者正在为亚马逊拍摄该系列的下一部电影。但事实证明，亚马逊创始人杰夫·贝索斯（Jeff Bezos）在做出最终决定方面也发挥了重要作用。在Semafor今天举行的“硅谷与世界”大会上，贝索斯[…]
